# Per-word rate or flat fee — which actually pays more per hour?

> Free calculator for freelance writers, copywriters, and ghostwriters comparing a per-word rate against a flat project fee for the same job -- computing the real effective hourly rate each pricing method pays once research and revision time are counted, and the price needed to hit an hourly income goal.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
